description: Status of an EVM transaction by hash: pending, success or failed, block, confirmations, timestamp, from/to, value, gas used, fee (plus L1 fee on Base/Optimism) and ERC-20 token transfers. Searches Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon if no chain is given. Use to confirm a payment settled.
name: evm_transaction_status
title: EVM Transaction Status
